# OmniComms AI

> The first unified voice-first AI solution for autonomous AI Employees.

OmniComms AI is the first unified voice-first AI solution for autonomous AI Employees. It provides unified business context for autonomous AI Employee execution — built for regulated professionals (loan officers, mortgage brokers, realtors, insurance agents, financial advisors) whose income depends on relationships and whose license depends on documentation. Tagline: "We help you scale You!"

**Capabilities**

- Voice-first interface: give instructions by speaking naturally
- Omnichannel: phone, SMS, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, Telegram, YouTube, Reddit
- Persistent memory: every conversation, every channel, every client — for years
- Human-in-the-loop: mission-critical actions require real-time approval via push notification
- Full audit trail: every interaction logged immutably for compliance

**AG-UI Integration — The Communications Layer for AI Agents**

OmniComms AI is integrating with AG-UI, the open agent-to-UI protocol (originated by CopilotKit, adopted by Microsoft Agent Framework, Google ADK, AWS Bedrock, LangGraph, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, and others). Our goal: become the universal communications layer for every AI Agent on the internet — so any AI Agent built on any framework can reach a real human across phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, or social DM with a single click.

- No server setup. No hosting required. No telephony stack to assemble.
- Bring your own agent: developers keep their own agent code, models, prompts, and orchestration — and extend it by wiring OmniComms AI in as the communication bridge/highway that pushes those interactions out into the real world (calls, texts, social messaging, email).
- Any AG-UI-compliant agent can plug into OmniComms AI and instantly gain real-world communication channels.
- Conversely, third-party AG-UI clients (CopilotKit dashboards, Microsoft Agent Framework UIs, custom apps) can run an OmniComms AI Employee through their own interface as a hosted agent.
- Roadmap: outbound bridge (third-party agents dispatch via our provider stack), inbound routing (incoming channel messages forwarded to a registered third-party agent), A2A discovery (Google Agent-to-Agent), and an MCP server exposing platform capabilities as tools any LLM can call.
- Outcome: every AG-UI developer ecosystem becomes a distribution channel for AI Employees — and every AI Agent on the internet gains a turnkey path to real human interaction.

**Section: The Problem**

- Headline: Every year, more professionals go independent.
- Body: Becoming "Solopreneurs." Some by choice. Some because the market decided for them.
- Body: Day one, the same two problems hit: How do I get leads? And when they come — how do I personally nurture hundreds of relationships by myself?
- Body: You can give 5 maybe 10 people your full attention. You cannot give 500.
- Accent: Not because you don't care. Because high-touch doesn't scale, until NOW.
- Accent: OmniComms AI is your leverage.

**Section: How It Works**

- Headline: Stop managing software. Start delegating.
- Body: When you hire a human employee, you give them a phone line, standard operating procedures, restricted access to company systems, and a workspace device. Your AI Employee is no different.
- Accent: Give it the same things — and it can hear, see what you see, and execute tasks.
- 01 — Tell it what to do: Give instructions with your voice — while you're driving, walking into a showing, or between calls. No typing required. Just talk.
- 02 — It sees everything: Your pipeline, your calendar, your conversations across every channel. Full context — not a blank prompt window.
- 03 — It acts on its own: Follows up with leads. Responds to texts. Sends documents. Schedules meetings. Takes real action — not just suggestions.
- 04 — It remembers forever: Every conversation, every channel, every client — for years. Context is never lost. And every interaction has a full audit trail.

Instead, I discovered a regulated relationship-based industry. You get one client, work on serving them for a while, then you have to run back to your pipeline to figure out which next client is ready. I spent years living this chaos until I learned the business and realized I needed to scale my capacity through automation. This is difficult to do in a people-based business. This is not a problem that I researched, I didn't interview people about it — I'm living it."

**Section: Why This Is Different**

- Headline: Built compliant-first. Not bolted on later.
- Comparison rows (Everyone else vs OmniComms AI):
  - Build the demo first. Figure out compliance later. Maybe. → Security architecture and audit infrastructure from line one of code. The demo came second.
  - Voice-only or chat-only. No memory across channels. → Calls, texts, emails — one AI that remembers every interaction across every channel. Do Not Call compliance built in.
  - Built by engineers who don't know your pain points nor how your industry works. → Built by a licensed broker who uses this on his own deals. His license is on the line.
  - Session context dies when the call ends. Next interaction starts from zero. → Context carries across calls, texts, and emails — for years. Your AI never forgets a client.
  - Fully autonomous. No guardrails. Hope for the best. → Human-in-the-loop. Mission-critical actions require your approval in real time.
  - Generic AI voice. Sounds like every other bot on the market. → Trained on your voice, your process, your personality. Every call, text, email redacted for sensitive information, used as context for your AI.
- Summary: Demos are cool. We're building real-world infrastructure good enough for regulated professionals.

**Section: Enterprise Security — Coming Soon**

- Headline: Your Keys. Your Data. Zero Trust Architecture.
- Body: Our platform is being built on a Zero Trust Master Key Architecture. Think of it like crypto — you hold the keys, not us.
- Encrypted at Rest: All data encrypted using keys that only you control. Powered by OpenBao vault infrastructure.
- Your Keys Required: The server cannot decrypt or access your data without your master key. We literally cannot see your information.
- Full Audit Trail: Every interaction logged immutably. Complete chain of custody for compliance officers and regulators.
- Note: Zero Trust Master Key Architecture is planned for our Enterprise tier. All tiers include end-to-end encryption and immutable audit logging from day one.

**Section: Human In The Loop**

- Headline: Your AI doesn't go rogue. You stay in control.
- Body: When your AI Employee hits a decision that matters — sending a contract, making a commitment, scheduling something irreversible — it doesn't just act.
- Accent: It asks you first. In real time via push notification and text.
- Flow: (1) AI identifies a mission-critical action → (2) You get a real-time prompt with full context → (3) Approve, deny, or modify — then it continues.
- Sub: Other AI tools are fully autonomous with no guardrails. For regulated professionals, that's not a feature — it's a liability.

**Section: Patent**

- Status: Patent Pending — filed November 16, 2025.
- Title: System and Method for Autonomous Multi-Modal Conversational AI Agent Operation Enabling Multi-Day Workflows Without Persistent Connections.
- Abstract: A system and method for autonomous multi-modal conversational AI agent operation enabling agents to conduct multi-day customer workflows without persistent connections or human intervention. The system provides event-driven agent activation enabling workflows spanning arbitrary time periods; cross-platform conversational continuity enabling agent access to complete conversation history regardless of communication platform; AI-triggered modality escalation enabling autonomous transition from asynchronous to synchronous communication with context preservation; resource-efficient scalability through separation of conversational state and compute processes; and runtime capability composition enabling agent behavior modification without code deployment.
- Field of invention: The present invention relates to autonomous conversational artificial intelligence systems for conducting complete customer workflows across multiple communication modalities and platforms without human intervention.

**Site structure**

The site is a single-page app served from https://omnicomms.ai/. Every route is reachable two ways and both render the same page: the clean URL (e.g. https://omnicomms.ai/terms) is a real static file returning 200 with full content, and the hash form (https://omnicomms.ai/#/terms) is the in-app route used for internal navigation. Prefer the clean URL when fetching. The link sections at the end of this file list every route; a machine-readable list is at https://omnicomms.ai/sitemap.xml

**SMS Text Messaging Program (A2P 10DLC)**

- Program: OmniCommsAI Inc. sends account-related notifications and requested marketing messages to customers and prospects who have opted in. Messages include webinar reminders and join links, password and account-setting changes, billing notices, service maintenance alerts, and marketing material requested at registration.
- Sending numbers: Messages may be sent from any number in the pool OmniCommsAI operates for this program; the sending number may vary. These numbers do not accept inbound voice calls.
- Opt-in method 1 (web form): Enter a mobile number and actively check the consent checkbox (never pre-selected) at https://omnicomms.ai/#/webinar or app.omnicomms.ai.
- Opt-in method 2 (QR code): Scan the QR code on OmniCommsAI marketing materials, which opens the same web form at https://omnicomms.ai/#/webinar.
- Opt-in method 3 (keyword): Text an opt-in keyword to the number shown on the campaign or marketing material, then reply Y to confirm.
- Opt-in keywords: AI, START, YES, UNSTOP
- Verification auto-reply (sent after the keyword): "OmniCommsAI: Reply Y to confirm you want webinar reminders, product updates & account alerts. Up to 6 msgs/mo. Msg&data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to cancel. Terms: omnicomms.ai/terms Privacy: omnicomms.ai/privacy"
- Opt-in confirmation message (sent after Y): "OmniCommsAI: You are now opted-in to account & marketing alerts. Up to 6 msgs/mo. Msg&data rates may apply. For help, reply HELP. To opt-out, reply STOP."
- Opt-out keywords: STOP, UNSUBSCRIBE, CANCEL, END, QUIT
- Help keywords: HELP, INFO
- Consent is not a condition of purchase.
- Message frequency: Message frequency varies, up to 6 messages per month.
- Rates: Message and data rates may apply depending on your mobile phone service plan.
- Help: Reply HELP for help, or email support@omnicomms.ai.
- Opt out: Reply STOP to cancel at any time.
- Delivery: Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.
- Mobile information sharing: No mobile information will be sold, rented, or shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties, excluding aggregators and providers of the text message services.
- SMS Terms: https://omnicomms.ai/terms (Section 19)
- SMS Privacy disclosure: https://omnicomms.ai/privacy (Section 14)

**Frequently Asked Questions**

Published at https://omnicomms.ai/blog. This is the authoritative wording on what the platform does today, including what is not built yet.

*The basics*

**Q: What is an AI Employee, and how is it different from a chatbot?**

A: A chatbot answers questions on your website. An AI Employee works a phone line. It answers inbound calls in a voice you choose, texts back instantly, and every one of those touches lands on the same contact record you already work from. The difference that matters is context. It carries what was said on a call in March into the text thread in July.

**Q: Will my clients know they are talking to AI?**

A: You decide how it introduces itself. The point was never to fool anyone. The point is that a lead who calls at 12:30 gets a real conversation instead of a voicemail nobody returns.

**Q: Do I need to be technical to set this up?**

A: No. This exists because stringing together a VOIP line, a texting app, a calendar, and a CRM that do not talk to each other is a software engineering project, and you should not have to be an engineer to run your own business. That is the part being replaced. The setup is also worth more than the time it saves you this week. Right now the context of your business is scattered across your email, your texts, your DMs, and phone calls you forget the moment you hang up. Every conversation you run through one place is context that stops getting lost. That captured context is the raw material for what your AI Employee will be able to do for you next, and most of that is not visible yet from where any of us are standing today. The businesses that start gathering it now are the ones that will be ready to use it.

*Compliance and your license*

**Q: How do you keep my outbound calls and texts compliant?**

A: Every outbound call and text is checked before it sends, not after. It is gated against the federal and state DNC registries, your own internal opt-outs, per-channel consent, and calling hours in the recipient's local time zone. A number blocked anywhere on the platform is blocked everywhere on it.

**Q: What happens when someone replies STOP?**

A: The contact is suppressed immediately, the one required confirmation reply goes out, and the whole thing is written to the audit log with a timestamp. If they later reply START, they are resubscribed, and that is logged too.

**Q: Can you monitor my agents texting from their personal phones?**

A: No, and be careful with anyone who tells you they can. Monitoring a rep's personal cell is wiretapping, so a vendor offering it is handing you a second legal problem on top of the one you already have. The only real fix is giving your team a channel so fast and so unified that they stop reaching for their personal phone. Once they are working in one place, every message is gated and logged without anyone having to remember to do it.

**Q: What can I actually hand a regulator?**

A: An audit log you cannot quietly edit. Every allow, every block, every opt-out, with the timestamp, who acted, and the reason the decision went the way it did. It exports.

**Q: Is consent to text the same as consent to call?**

A: No, and treating them as the same is one of the most common ways careful people still get caught. SMS consent, voice consent, and email consent are tracked separately and enforced separately, so a contact who agreed to texts does not quietly become someone you are allowed to dial.

**Q: Can I record a call legally when a third party joins?**

A: This is one of the things the platform is unusually good at. When you loop in a lender, a title rep, or a co-borrower mid-call, the platform dials them first and an AI rides that leg to capture their explicit consent before they are merged into the live call. The consent is in the recording and in the audit trail, which is what a two-party consent state expects to see.

*Speed to lead*

**Q: What happens to a lead that calls when nobody is available?**

A: An AI picks up and has an actual conversation instead of sending them to voicemail. If the caller would rather not wait for a human, they can hold their place for a callback, and that callback lands in your pipeline as a real task rather than a sticky note on your monitor.

**Q: How fast does an inbound text get answered?**

A: Immediately, and automatically. Speed to lead is close to the whole ballgame in this business, and the second fastest responder usually gets nothing at all.

**Q: Everything lives in four different tools. Can I get it into one place?**

A: That is the core of it. Calls, texts, and messages sit against one contact, on one number, in one timeline. You can bring your existing book in by CSV and it dedupes on exact phone and email as it loads, so you are not importing the same client three times.

*Fit, ownership, and honest limits*

**Q: Who owns the data and the AI Employee I train?**

A: You do. Your way of working is the asset here, and the whole premise is helping you deploy it rather than harvesting it. We are not trying to end up owning your secret sauce.

**Q: Who is this for?**

A: Any business where the deal is won or lost in the conversation. If your clients come to you through calls, texts, DMs, and months of follow up rather than a checkout button, and you are carrying more relationships than one person can honestly keep straight, you are the profile. Compliance pressure makes it more urgent, but it is not what makes it useful. We started with insurance, real estate, mortgage, and auto F&I because those are the ones we know best and the pain shows up loudest there. The underlying problem is not specific to them. If your team is running on personal phones, a free texting app, and a CRM nobody updates, the same thing is happening to you.

**Q: What is not built yet?**

A: Worth saying out loud. There is no automated nurture sequence engine yet, no lead scoring or auto qualification, and no business hours routing logic. Matching the same person across channels works on an exact phone or email match, not on fuzzy identity. The compliance gate runs before a call is placed, not live during one. All of that is being built. None of it is something you should buy on today.
